headline: Western Carriers submits AGM scrutiny report and voting results
hook: AGM voting results submitted to exchanges
summary: Western Carriers (India) Limited has filed the scrutinizer's report and voting results for its Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026. The regulatory filing provides shareholders and exchanges with the formal outcomes of resolutions put to vote. Routine corporate disclosures like this ensure governance transparency for listed entities. Indian retail investors holding the stock can review the approved resolutions in the official exchange filings.
why_it_matters: Routine corporate governance filing with no direct price impact
